title: Run the app as a Google Cloud Run function
prompt: We want to deploy this Inferlo app as a Google Cloud Run function. Create src/index.ts that registers an HTTP function named "inferlo" with @google-cloud/functions-framework, serving the whole Inferlo app exported from src/app.ts: GET /health reaches the app's health endpoint, /openapi.json serves its OpenAPI document and POST /notes reaches POST /notes with its JSON body.
